page.overview:
Who is Bobby?

Bobby is a hero and the Farmworld equivalent of Billy.

He first appears in the episode "Crossover," where almost his whole body shown to be encased in ice in Farmworld Finn's attempt to "save" humanity. Bobby gave the main universe Finn instructions on using the gem. Finn took it and thanked Bobby while calling him “Billy” but the hero corrected him. He was presumably freed from his frozen prison after the crown was destroyed.

Bobby is a medium height, tan skinned male human adult. Like Billy, he wears a band on his head bearing a blue gem at nose height. His hair seems to be a faded white, and his outfit matches one of a knight.

Bobby, like Billy, has the ability to use the band on his head to activate the Enchiridion by shooting a blue beam of light at it when all the Crown Jewels are inserted.
